_howto_edit: GitHub par seedha niche diye gaye hex codes, fonts, persona ya custom rules edit karo aur commit kar do. Pipeline har run par yehi file live read karegi.

2_channel_persona_and_pacing.tts_voice_prompt: Read in a gripping, brisk, cinematic documentary storyteller voice
2_channel_persona_and_pacing.hook_rule: First 90 frames (1.5s) must expose a brutal numeric anomaly or visual contradiction.

banned_patterns: Full spoken sentence subtitles pasted across center screen
Linear easing (must use spring solver or cubic-bezier)
Unbounded floating boxes without grid alignment

5_custom_user_rules: Har beat mein ek clear physical/visual metaphor hona chahiye, sirf text cards nahi.
Numbers aur percentages ko hamesha mono font aur glowing accent color mein dikhao.
Use the 6-swatch Rooster palette (#3B2336 Aubergine, #009E83 Jade Teal, #F24414 Vermilion, #F38BA8 Flamingo Pink, #FBA40D Marigold, #E7E4DD Bone Cream).
